verdict.rationale: Docusign publishes an official Node.js client library for the eSign REST API. Its OpenAPI-Specifications repo states the specs are used to generate its client SDKs (plural) with swagger-codegen, so official SDKs clearly exist to build against. Community reports praise integration speed and documentation thoroughness, though these concern the REST API generally rather than the SDKs specifically. Missing for 10: documented coverage of SDK languages beyond Node.js, in-depth SDK reference and quickstart evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration specific to the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Official Docusign Node.js Client Library used to interact with the eSign REST API.
